title: phyllanthus zollingeri
intro: Phyllanthus zollingeri, commonly known as Zollinger's phyllanthus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against oxidative stress, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus zollingeri include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, antipyretic, and antiviral effects. The plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, pain, and respiratory infections, and its extracts have shown potential in inhibiting the growth of certain microorganisms and reducing inflammation.
